description: This Python test script scans the 'litellm' and 'enterprise' directory trees for hardcoded 'litellm.set_verbose = True' assignments in Python files, to prevent verbose mode from being set directly in production code. It raises an assertion or exception if such assignments are found, enforcing best practices for configuration management.

methods.name: find_set_verbose_assignments(file_path)
methods.description: Parses a Python file to find assignments to 'litellm.set_verbose' with value True, returning a list of line numbers and the line text where such assignments occur.

methods.name: scan_litellm_files(base_dir)
methods.description: Scans specified base directory under 'litellm' and 'enterprise' for Python files containing 'litellm.set_verbose = True' assignments, returning a dictionary mapping file paths to such assignments.

methods.name: test_no_hardcoded_set_verbose()
methods.description: Pytest-compatible test that asserts no 'litellm.set_verbose = True' hardcoded assignments exist in the scanned files, raising an AssertionError if violations are found.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the scan, reports found violations, and instructs to remove hardcoded verbosity settings, advocating for configuration-based approaches.
